name: leescan-v2
run: cd /work && python -m py_compile leefast.py test_leefast.py v1ref.py > /out/compile.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/compile.txt; exit $rc

cd /work && python leefast.py --fetch-only > /out/fetch.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/fetch.txt; sha256sum leefast.py test_leefast.py v1ref.py leescan.py aprime_smooth.py emuframe.py aleph-fig5.json | tee /out/sha256.txt; exit $rc
cd /work && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m unittest -v test_leefast > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests.txt; exit $rc

cd /work && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 python leefast.py --out /out --ntoys 2000 --workers 2 --budget-s 14000 > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^(CLOSURE|OBSCHECK|OBSDIFF|OBS |TRUTH|TOYS|TOYCHECK|TOYDIFF|toys done|budget|LEEFAST|LEESCAN)' /out/run.txt; tail -n 30 /out/run.txt; exit $rc
